q: The Contraction Mapping Theorem (Banach Fixed-Point Theorem) requires the map T: X → X to satisfy:
opts: There exists k < 1 such that d(Tx,Ty) ≤ k·d(x,y) for all x,y
exp: A contraction requires a uniform Lipschitz constant k < 1. The theorem then guarantees a unique fixed point and gives an explicit convergence rate for iterates.
